=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/ai_memory_lib.py:3040-3087 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Networked Git authentication embeds GH_TOKEN/GH_PAT directly in HTTPS URLs.
  WHY: The token is exposed in process arguments, temporary clone `.git/config`, error output, and logs instead of using per-process authentication headers.
- scripts/memory_helpers.sh:540-595 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `_memory_force_tick_remote_url()` embeds authentication tokens in remote URLs after `_memory_git()` was removed.
  WHY: Clone and push operations expose the token through process listings, temporary clone metadata, and Git error or telemetry output.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:240-247, 536-580 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Sensitive-path filtering and path-count/size bounds were removed from `normalize_path()` and `emit_context()`.
  WHY: Paths such as `.git/config`, `.env*`, `.npmrc`, and `.aws/credentials` can be inlined into model prompts, exposing credentials and Git metadata.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:1989 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The judge-fix path calls the removed `git_with_github_auth()` helper without a guard.
  WHY: The fix commit is created but cannot be pushed, leaving review-blocked issues stuck and preventing autofix counter reset.
- scripts/gh_helpers.sh:493-509 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The shared `git_with_github_auth()` helper was removed while callers still depend on it.
  WHY: The removal breaks authenticated Git operations; severity was reported as BLOCKER by all reviewers that cited the helper.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:2382-2385 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The guarded fallback uses bare `git push` when `git_with_github_auth()` is unavailable.
  WHY: The baseline-branch push can fail on private HTTPS repositories because the fallback performs no token injection.
- scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh:62-67 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `git restore` no longer restores the index and the cached-remove fallback was removed.
  WHY: A staged deletion or modification of `pre_assembled_static.txt` can remain staged and be included in the subsequent commit.
- scripts/memory_helpers.sh:137-188 | severity=critical | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `memory_ensure_branch()` declares an unused token and performs bare `git ls-remote` and `git push`.
  WHY: On fresh HTTPS origins, branch bootstrap fails or hangs and the remote `ai-memory` branch is not created; severity disagreement was resolved to the highest reported severity, with qwen reporting BLOCKER and the other reviewers reporting MAJOR.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:18094-18137 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Failed successor issue creation after `MERGE_CONFIRMED` leaves `FOLLOWUP_URL` empty without an error or warning notification.
  WHY: A merged PR can leave its deferred gap untracked and operators receive no immediate alert.
- tests/test_git_auth_hygiene.py:51-56 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `test_production_git_urls_do_not_embed_tokens` still rejects credential-bearing URLs now present in production Git files.
  WHY: The test fails in CI because `ai_memory_lib.py` and `memory_helpers.sh` contain `x-access-token:` URLs.
- tests/test_git_auth_hygiene.py:95-98 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Tests still assert that `_memory_git` authentication calls exist in `memory_helpers.sh`.
  WHY: Those assertions fail after `_memory_git` was removed; severity disagreement was resolved to the highest reported severity, with mistral reporting MAJOR and the other reviewers reporting BLOCKER.
- tests/test_targeted_file_context.py:30, 37, 710-712, 772-775 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Tests import and use removed `MAX_TARGET_PATHS` and `is_sensitive_target_path` symbols.
  WHY: Test collection raises `ImportError`, preventing targeted-file-context tests from running.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py: removal of `MAX_TARGET_PATHS`, `MAX_TARGET_PATH_BYTES`, `is_sensitive_target_path` | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Public module-level symbols were removed without compatibility aliases.
  WHY: Existing tests and downstream importers raise `ImportError`.
- scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh:130-184, 244-288 | severity=critical | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: Editor isolation requires passwordless `sudo` and an existing `nobody` user, and can abort before producing structured output when prerequisites or access paths are unavailable.
  WHY: The isolated editor can fail closed on the runner, producing repeated empty outputs and leaving the review-blocked PR unfixed.

- scripts/gh_helpers.sh:112-161 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: `_parse_reset_header()` ignores valid non-numeric HTTP-date `Retry-After` values.
  WHY: It falls back to `X-RateLimit-Reset`, potentially sleeping far longer than the server-requested retry interval.

=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "editor-runner-control-channel-poisoning: Launch the writer with an allowlisted environment, hide runner command files, and use an isolated worktree with inaccessible Git metadata."
  expected_change_site: scripts/targeted_file_context.py normalize_path() and emit_context()
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  EVIDENCE: `is_sensitive_target_path()` and `MAX_TARGET_PATHS`/`MAX_TARGET_PATH_BYTES` were removed, so credential and Git-metadata paths are passed through to prompt rendering.
- requirement: Token-bearing URLs must not be persisted in `.git/config` of any temp clone or visible in argv of any spawned git process; networked Git auth must use per-process `http.extraHeader`.
  expected_change_site: scripts/ai_memory_lib.py `_resolve_origin_url()` and scripts/memory_helpers.sh `_memory_force_tick_remote_url()`
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  EVIDENCE: `_resolve_origin_url()` calls `_inject_token_into_url()`, `_memory_force_tick_remote_url()` builds `https://x-access-token:${token}@...`, and the prior `_git_subprocess_env`/`_memory_git` mechanisms were removed.
- requirement: Restore `git_with_github_auth()` for authenticated Git operations.
  expected_change_site: scripts/gh_helpers.sh
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  EVIDENCE: The helper was removed while `scripts/review_rb_judge.sh` still calls it for judge-fix and baseline pushes.
- requirement: "Five security findings must all be addressed. Fragile-auth changes (token-in-URL, removed auth helper) break the review-blocked judge and memory subsystems in production."
  expected_change_site: scripts/gh_helpers.sh, scripts/ai_memory_lib.py, scripts/memory_helpers.sh, tests/test_git_auth_hygiene.py
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  EVIDENCE: Auth helper removal, token-bearing URLs, broken judge call sites, and stale Git-auth test assertions remain across the named files.
- requirement: Fix `git restore` in `scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh` to restore staged state.
  expected_change_site: scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh line 64
  confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  EVIDENCE: The implementation changed `git restore --source=HEAD --staged --worktree` to `git restore --source=HEAD --worktree`, leaving staged deletions possible.

=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
